commit_reviewed_note: Implementation SHA for R2-02 methodology review. Not the final evidence SHA. Storage-systems review already PASS_WITH_CAVEATS at this SHA; this review does not re-adjudicate storage semantics.

genuine_stale_causality_not_synthetic_cl.rationale: run_genuine_stale_precondition creates S0 from genuine_stale_scenario_fixture, applies a competing same-scope command at S0 prepare_authority, then applies the prepared command still bound to S0 via from_transition_pair(prepare_authority, prepared_target). Rejection is the live scoped CAS mismatch after the competing apply, not scenario_id-forced classification and not the synthetic stale_preconditions path (analysis:stale / head+1 / generation-1). That synthetic path remains only for non-01B3/01C3 candidates. Review/reuse use the same target twice after the first apply advances the scoped token; analysis uses two oracle-valid distinct targets from one S0. scenario_id selects the fixture only.

prepared_precondition_captured_before_co.rationale: The stale command is constructed with S0 tokens via from_transition_pair(prepare_authority, …), so the executed precondition is the S0 token. The recorded prepared_precondition field is not a live handle snapshot taken before the competing apply. It is reconstructed after rejection by prepared_precondition_label(scope, &fixture.prepare_authority) from the S0 fixture label (review_ledger_head=… / reuse_governance_head=… / active_analysis_snapshot_identity=…). Content matches the S0 token that was used; capture timing is post-hoc fixture reconstruction, not a pre-compete live snapshot.

authority_changed_in_relevant_scope_dire.rationale: Harness reads live normalized_state after the competing apply and compares the scoped token against fixture.prepare_authority via authority_changed_in_relevant_scope (review_ledger_head, reuse_governance_head, or active_analysis_snapshot_identity). The boolean passed into record_genuine is that live comparison, not a scenario-label inference. Incomplete observation fails the run (genuine-stale-observation-incomplete).

stale_rejection_distinguished_from_dupli.rationale: Harness and c1_stale tests require the exact scoped code (stale-review-ledger-precondition / stale-reuse-governance-precondition / stale-analysis-selection-precondition). Any other Err(code) fails the scenario; Ok(()) fails as expected {code}. Those codes are distinct from semantic-duplicate-transition, failed_oracle_compare, stale-full-state-unrelated-rewind, and oracle/validate_state failures. validate_scoped_preconditions returns before apply_onto/persist, so a stale reject is not an oracle-forced or duplicate-transition reject.

post_rejection_non_mutation_observed.rationale: Harness snapshots authority_after_competing and authority_after_rejection from the open handle and requires both post_rejection_authority_unchanged (structural ==) and post_rejection_oracle_compare. Review unit tests do the same in-handle. Reuse and analysis unit tests assert in-handle equality and the expected failure code but do not call record_genuine. That unit-test gap does not remove the harness observation.

reopen_evidence_independent_of_semantic_.rationale: Harness closes the writer and opens a new read-only handle, then records persist_reopen_authority_unchanged as structural == of independently reopened state versus post-competing handle state. That check does not go through CurrentContractOracle. persist_reopen_oracle_compare is an additional oracle check, not the only reopen evidence. Not compare(actual, actual) and not adapter-return-only. Reuse/analysis unit tests omit close/reopen; review unit tests and the shared harness cover persist+reopen.

abc_identities_recorded_not_inferred_fro.rationale: Analysis observations persist analysis_identity_before, competing_identity_after, and stale_command_target_identity as concrete strings from GenuineStaleAnalysisDetails, not from scenario_id text. Those strings are fixture-projected from prepare_authority / competing_target / prepared_target durable tokens at fixture construction. record_genuine copies the fixture details; it does not re-read live handle identities. Unit tests check that live competing identity equals competing_identity_after. Review/reuse records omit A/B/C fields (analysis_details is None), which is correct for those scopes.

pairwise_distinct_identities_determinist.rationale: At the executed Small scale, A/B/C are deterministic projections of the measurement fixtures and identities_pairwise_distinct is A!=B && A!=C && B!=C, gated in the harness and in genuine_stale_fixtures_cover_three_scopes_with_distinct_analysis_targets. Same scale yields the same strings. Medium is scale-fragile (B and C can collide) and is not the harness scale.

append_sqlite_observations_equivalent_fo.rationale: Both candidates use the same fixtures, same run_genuine_stale_precondition, same Fcr03StaleRejectionRecord schema, same expected codes, and the same close/reopen observation gates. That is enough for logical scoped-validity / persist-reopen comparison. Latent Append replace versus SQLite merge of analysis_snapshots is an apply-path difference not on the reject path and must not be treated as demonstrated apply-equivalence. Reuse/analysis unit tests omit reopen on both sides; harness equalizes them.

claims_bounded_to_logical_scoped_validit.rationale: Stale scenario contracts declare fault_layer LogicalReturnedError, fault_point none, allowed_evidence_strength InterfaceBehavior, and reopen_required true. Demonstrated strength is logical scoped-validity plus persist-reopen of logical authority after close/open. persist-reopen is not FilesystemDurability. Contracts under-claim relative to persist-reopen (InterfaceBehavior rather than LogicalStateTransition); that is conservative, not an overclaim.

accidental_filesystem_durability_or_prod.rationale: Reviewed scenario, observation, fixture, and c1_stale test files do not credit FilesystemDurability, HardwarePowerLoss, CrossPlatform, or production-integration. close/reopen is logical persist-reopen. Analysis S0 is evidence-composed (two-root source_revisions / cross-scale second command), not a production single-transcript lifecycle. Stale contracts have empty prohibited_claims, but allowed_evidence_strength InterfaceBehavior still bars durability credit.

caveats: prepared_precondition is reconstructed from the S0 fixture label after rejection, not captured as a live handle snapshot before the competing command.
Analysis A/B/C identities are fixture-projected and copied into the record; harness does not live-read handle tokens into those three fields.
Reuse and analysis unit tests omit close/reopen and do not populate Fcr03StaleRejectionObservation; review unit tests and run_genuine_stale_precondition cover persist+reopen.

close_reopen_performed, competing_transition_applied, stale_command_applied, and transition_applied are constructor-assigned in record_genuine; the harness still performs close/reopen and gates on the computed compare/unchanged fields.
Pairwise-distinct analysis identities are demonstrated at Small only; Medium is scale-fragile and must not be treated as shown.
Analysis C is an evidence-composed cross-scale second command, not a same-transcript production rival. Pairwise-distinct fixture identities do not prove two production analysis commands at one S0.
Append versus SQLite analysis_snapshots replace-versus-merge is latent apply-path divergence and is not comparison evidence on the reject path.
Stale scenario contracts leave prohibited_claims empty; durability must still not be credited. persist-reopen remains logical close/open, not FilesystemDurability.
This review is of implementation SHA ee509e3, not a frozen evidence run. No 01C scenario-results.json at a final evidence SHA was in scope.

may_claim: 01B-3 and 01C-3 genuine stale harness scenarios establish competing same-scope apply then S0-bound command rejection with the required scoped failure codes.
authority_changed_in_relevant_scope is observed from live post-competing handle tokens versus S0.
Post-rejection non-mutation is observed in-handle; harness persist-reopen observes the competing authority on a new read-only handle via structural equality plus oracle compare.
Analysis A/B/C identity strings are recorded as fixture-projected values and are pairwise distinct at Small.
Append and SQLite rejection observations share schema, codes, and harness gates enough for logical scoped-validity / persist-reopen comparison.
Demonstrated claim class is logical scoped-validity and persist-reopen of logical authority (InterfaceBehavior contract; persist-reopen is not FilesystemDurability).
may_not_claim: prepared_precondition was live-captured from the handle before the competing command
A/B/C identities were live-observed from the handle in the harness record path
Pairwise-distinct identities prove two production same-transcript analysis commands at one S0
Reuse/analysis unit tests independently prove persist-reopen
FilesystemDurability, HardwarePowerLoss, process-crash recovery, or cross-platform from these scenarios
Production-integration or current projection-lifecycle support for multi-root source_revisions / cross-scale analysis C
Evidence execution, final SHA freeze, Sol STRONG_FINAL, Opus PRE_FINAL, mechanism selection, or FINAL_GATE
Conflict-register 'durable authority unchanged after reopen' as FilesystemDurability

bottom_line: R2-02 genuine stale observation methodology is sufficient to close the methodology gate: competing-then-S0-bound causality, exact scoped failure codes, live scoped-token change, post-reject non-mutation, and harness persist-reopen independent of the oracle via structural ==. Remaining caveats are capture provenance (reconstructed S0 label; fixture-projected identities) and unit-test reopen omission for reuse/analysis. No durability or production-integration claim is supported. Close R2-02 methodology; proceed to R2-05 package provenance correction.
